answer: Each epoch, at a randomized horizon in the block window, the chain samples one archived answer and challenges its author to re-derive the reasoning against a fresh nonce minted that instant, so no cached transcript can pass. The verifier reruns the derivation, compares the live delta to the stored one, and broadcasts a signed pulse of match or mismatch to peers. A single mismatch triggers a second audit; two mismatches freeze the identity's emission and flag it for review, forcing the attacker to forge live reasoning rather than replay old text.
